description.value: Ton Ton Sushi is a Japanese-Korean sushi restaurant on West Broadway in Vancouver, offering a menu that includes vegan and vegetarian options alongside traditional sushi. The restaurant operates an online ordering platform and mobile app. It sits on a busy cycling corridor (Broadway), making it a plausible mid-ride or post-ride stop.
